treaty_name: Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Singapore and the Government of the Republic of Armenia for the elimination of double taxation with respect to taxes on income and the prevention of tax evasion and avoidance (2019)
eif_quote: [SG list] jurisdiction=Armenia | title=DTA | inforce=Yes | mli=No | docurl=.../singapore-armenia-dta-(ratified)-(23-dec-2021).pdf; text: DONE in duplicate at Singapore on this 8th day of July 2019.
source_title: AM-SG Agreement, English text (scanned PDF SINGAPORE_DoubleTaxationTreaty_EN, Armenian MoF archive), pages read visually

rates.quote: (a) 0 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is (i) a company which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends; or (ii) a company which invested at least USD 300,000 (or the equivalent amount in any other currency) in the share capital of the company paying the dividends;
(b) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

However, such interest may be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 percent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding the other provisions of this Agreement, a benefit under this Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of this Agreement.

notes: Dividend 0% tier also available (alternative to >=25% holding) to a company that invested at least USD 300,000 in the share capital of the payer (not modelled separately). Art. 10(3)/11(3): dividends and interest paid to the Government of the other State (incl. central bank/MAS, statutory bodies, GIC entities; Armenian subdivisions, local authorities, Central Bank), interest on loans guaranteed by the source Government and interest paid to wholly government-owned financial institutions are exempt (not modelled). Art. 28: in Singapore WHT on amounts paid on or after 1 January of the year following EIF; in Armenia WHT on income derived on or after 1 January of the year following EIF (EIF 2021-12-23 -> 2022-01-01). Not MLI-modified (IRAS: mli=No); PPT in treaty Art. 27.
